goal: Say why you want this job and why you are a good choice, without exaggerating.

phrases.text: I am interested in this job because ...

meaning.roman: Mujhe yeh job is liye pasand hai ke ...

phrases.example: I am interested in this job because I enjoy working with customers.

phrases.text: I think I can help the team by ...

meaning.roman: Mera khayal hai ke main ... ke zariye team ki madad kar sakta/sakti hoon.

phrases.example: I think I can help the team by learning fast and working carefully.

phrases.text: I want to grow in this field.

meaning.roman: Main is field mein aage barhna chahta/chahti hoon.

phrases.example: I want to grow in this field and learn from experienced people.
I would be happy to start with any task you give me.

roleplay.tutor_line: Why do you want to work here?

task.roman: Batayein ke aap yeh job kyun karna chahte hain.

roleplay.model_answer: I am interested in this job because I enjoy working with people. I also want to learn new skills.

roleplay.tutor_line: Why should we choose you for this job?

task.roman: Batayein ke aap ek achhe umeedwar kyun hain: do wajahat dein, bina barha-chadha kar.

roleplay.model_answer: I think I can help the team by learning fast and working carefully. I am also always on time.

roleplay.tutor_line: What do you know about this kind of work?

task.roman: Batayein ke aap is tarah ke kaam ke baare mein kya jaante hain.

roleplay.model_answer: I know that this work needs patience and good communication. I understand how important it is to listen carefully.

roleplay.tutor_line: What would you like to learn in this job?

task.roman: Batayein ke aap is job mein kya seekhna chahte hain.

roleplay.model_answer: I want to grow in this field. I would like to learn from experienced people and take more responsibility with time.

roleplay.tutor_line: If the work begins with a small task, how would you feel about that?

task.roman: Agar shuru mein chhota kaam diya jaye to apna jawab batayein.

roleplay.model_answer: I would be happy to start with any task you give me. I always learn something new from small tasks.

review_notes: Turn 2 teaches a modest answer ('I think I can help'). Some interviewers want a stronger one. Is the tone right for your market?
